scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-workspace/shared && npm run build -w @ai-workspace/api && npm run build -w @ai-workspace/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @ai-workspace/api & npm run dev -w @ai-workspace/web & wait
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-workspace/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ai-workspace/api && npm run typecheck -w @ai-workspace/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ai-workspace/shared && npm run test -w @ai-workspace/api
